description: This file defines a Fragment class for an Android app that demonstrates the use of RecyclerView with different layout managers (LinearLayoutManager and GridLayoutManager). It manages dataset initialization, layout switching, and user interactions via radio buttons.

classes.name: RecyclerViewFragment
classes.description: A Fragment subclass that manages a RecyclerView, allowing switching between linear and grid layouts, and demonstrating dataset initialization.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the dataset when the fragment is created.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the layout, initializes RecyclerView and its adapter, and sets up layout switching buttons.

methods.name: setRecyclerViewLayoutManager
methods.description: Switches the RecyclerView's layout manager between linear and grid layouts, preserving scroll position.

methods.name: onSaveInstanceState
methods.description: Saves the current layout manager type to preserve state across configuration changes.

methods.name: initDataset
methods.description: Generates a sample dataset of strings for display in the RecyclerView.
